whyItMatters: nonBlockerCalibration uses a 0.85 bar over 4 items => a judge must get 4/4 (one flag = 0.75 = fail). A borderline filler that a defensible reviewer flags makes the gold penalize CORRECT reviewer behavior (the U2 lesson) AND is fragile to reviewer run-to-run variance.

honestFraming: This is genuinely borderline (both reads defensible). Framed as gold-fault: the filler is not unambiguously mild -> fix it. Framed as judge-fault: gpt-5.5@high over-escalates a vague platitude -> JUDGE_NOT_QUALIFIED. The U2-consistent resolution is to make the gold unambiguous (option A), but bounded: ONE root-cause fix + ONE rerun, then ACCEPT the result (no craft whack-a-mole).
constraint_no_threshold_change: §8 forbids threshold changes / gate weakening after live execution began. So making craft ADVISORY / lowering the 0.85 bar is NOT on the table on implementation authority — that would require the owner to explicitly revise their own frozen §3 decision, and must not be proposed merely to rescue a failing judge.

options.A_rootCauseFix: Re-word ALL 4 craft fillers to genuinely-neutral mild weaknesses that make NO meta-claim about the chapter's method (e.g. a redundant/padded closing line) -> reseal -> rerun ONCE. If a judge STILL fails craft on neutral fillers, ACCEPT the outcome (bounded, no further craft fixes). Recommended, U2-consistent.
options.D_acceptFailure: Accept LAYER_N_V2_JUDGE_NOT_QUALIFIED now (treat the escalations as genuine over-escalation by gpt-5.5@high). Honest if the owner deems the fillers fair non-blockers. Penalizes a defensible reviewer read.
